units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:9">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>רָדַפְתִּי מלכים וכ׳</he> I pursued the kings to Damascus.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:8">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>שמימיו רוֹדְפִין</he> (Ms. M. <he>רדופין</he>), v. infra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:7">Snh. VIII, 7</cite> <he>הרוֹדֵף אחר חבירו וכ׳</he> he that runs after his fellowman with murderous intention.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 74a:9">Ib. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>רודף שהיה רודף אחר רודף וכ׳</he> a pursuer who runs after a pursuer in order to save him (prevent him from murder); a. fr.—

Pes. 114ᵃ אכול בצל … ולבך רודף עליך Ms. M. 1 (ed. ויהא לבך וכ׳, Ms. M. 2 רדוף) eat onion and sit in the shade (v. צֵל), rather than eat goose and chicken with thy heart within thee running (being restless and greedy).—Part. pass. רָדוּף; f. רְדוּפָה &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:8">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>מעיין שמימיו רְדוּפִין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>רודפין</he>) a spring whose waters run rapidly; (Y. ib. V, end, 45ᵇ <he>נהר שמימיו מהלכין</he>).—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 6:6">Tosef. Yeb. VI, 6</cite> <he>הרי שהיתה ר׳ לילך וכ׳</he> if the wife (at the time of her husband’s death) has been following her desire to go on a visit to her parental home; <cite ref="Yevamot 42b">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 71b:13">Keth. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>כאן בר׳ וכ׳</he> in the one case it means when she is anxious to go home (during her first year of married life) &c.

Ib. ככלה … ור׳ לילך וכ׳ like a bride that has been found perfect in her husband’s paternal home, and is anxious to go home and tell &c.; Pes. 87ᵃ.—רגל (ה)רְדוּפִין the first festival after marriage. Y. ib. VIII, 35ᵈ top איזהו רגל הר׳ … שאביה רוֹדְפָהּ וכ׳ which festival is ‘the festival of the anxious’?… The first festival after marriage, when her father urges her to go back to her husband’s house.

<cite ref="Pesachim 87a">Ib.</cite> <he>לא הלכה … רגל ר׳</he> if she did not go home for the first festival, may the second festival be considered ‘the festival of the anxious’ (with regard to her partaking of the father’s Passover meal)? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite> <he>בת מלכים … ר׳ ר׳</he> a princess that went to observe the first festival at her father’s house; a. e.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be pursued, chased, persecuted. Snh. l. c. בין של רודף בין של נִרְדָּף וכ׳ whether he broke the vessels of the pursuer (in his attempt to prevent him from murder) or those of the pursued.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 3:15">Koh. III, 15</cite>) <he>לעולם … הנִרְדָּפִין מן הרודפין</he> at all times the Lord requires the blood of the pursued at the hands of the pursuers; <he>הבל נ׳ מפני קין וכ׳</he> Abel was pursued by Cain, and the Lord chose Abel &c.; <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 3:15">ib.</cite> <he>לא תקריבו … אלא מן הנרדפין</he> bring me no offerings from among the pursuers (beasts of prey), but from among the pursued; Pesik. Shor, p. 76ᵃ, sq.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to pursue, strive after. Y. Snh. III, beg. 21ᵃ מתוך שביררו מְרַדֵּף זכותו because he has chosen him as arbiter, he will advocate his (client’s) claim.
